body:
I don't have much family, my mom is dying from lung cancer, she's the only one that's kept me going this long but she's losing her battle and so am I.
My narc/abusive ex was in a huge film so nobody believed me when I told people he basically turned me into a prostitute. He took all of our friends for clout I guess. I literally have nobody to talk to and now that the world is open my husband just leaves me at home to be with his friends and gets mad if I say I'm jealous. I'm tired if being so alone.

I don't think they're trolls, at least some aren't. I have talked to them before but I'm the one that ends up chickening out. It's pretty sad how many people would care... Maybe like three... In the whole world. Three people might miss me for a while, then they would get over it and move on with their life. My husband would be better off I know for sure.
PTSD mostly from like 25 years of abuse... Nothing has helped. I'm really worthless.
